messages:
maggie: heads up — eu-west3 provisioning flares. multiple GPU pods failed to bind, kube logs show 'attach held: disk iops exceeded threshold'.

maggie: checked one affected host: iostat shows nvme at 100% util while model prewarm was running.

maggie: snippet:
```
% iostat -xm 1 2
Device: rrqm/s wrqm/s r/s w/s rkB/s wkB/s avgrq-sz avgqu-sz await r_await w_await svctm %util
nvme0n1 0.00 0.00 1100.00 2900.00 2200.00 4600.00 2.02 38.10 1.45 0.38 1.80 0.27 100.00
```

maggie: dmesg shows `nvme: I/O ... timeout, resetting controller` messages but no SMART failure. looks like transient IO saturation.

sam: recall we increased prewarm replicas (2->6) last week to cut cold starts. might be correlated.

raj: confirmed trend in metrics — after the rollout gpu-attach-errors went up x20 in eu-west3 and node nvme %util spiked during the prewarm windows.

izzy: immediate mitigation ideas: 1) scale prewarm back to 2 per model; 2) set PREWARM_PARALLELISM=1; 3) avoid scheduling warmups in scrub window (02:00-04:00 UTC).

maggie: scaled back to 2 and set env var. triggering rollout now.

ops-bot: deploy triggered by maggie: reduce-prewarm -> rollout started (canary 20%).

sam: medium-term: implement per-node rate limiter for warmup downloads (token-bucket), and/or cgroups blkio throttle for prewarm workers so they can't starve janitor or system processes.

raj: also propose an alert: per-node nvme_util > 85% && gpu_attach_errors > 1/min -> page SRE. add dashboard tile for prewarm concurrency by node.

izzy: alternative: change prewarm flow to fetch model artifacts into tmpfs or network cache first (cpu-stage), then atomically write to nvme to reduce concurrent writes. avoid simultaneous downloads + janitor scrub.

maggie: tradeoffs: lowering prewarm concurrency reduces attach failures but increases cold-start p95; that might force us to buy more reserved GPU capacity. sam, can you run a cost delta for a targeted reserved pool for hot models?

sam: will run numbers. ballpark: targeted reserved pool for top 20 models adds ~30-40% cost to eu-west3 inference fleet but reduces attach churn and improves SLOs. detailed spreadsheet tomorrow.

raj: i'll prototype a lightweight token-bucket sidecar that rejects/queues warmup pulls per node and a K8s admission hook to enforce rate. aim to have a PoC within a week.

maggie: can we also short-term exempt janitor from aggressive scrub during peak prewarm windows? ops schedule is tight but worth evaluating.

izzy: agreed. add a scheduler rule to avoid running janitor scrubs on nodes flagged for heavy warmup in the last hour.

maggie: rollout canary looks good — early signal: attach errors dropped from ~4% to 0.7% in eu-west3.

izzy: action items: ["Implement per-node warmup rate limiter (raj)", "Scheduler rule to avoid warmups during scrub window (izzy)", "Reserved GPU cost analysis for hot models (sam)", "Add alert/dashboard for nvme util + attach errors (maggie/monitoring)"]

sam: i'll post the cost calc tomorrow.

maggie: filing a short incident note and linking to ops postmortem if this recurs. :thumbsup:
